item.title: Legislature repasses Trussville Personnel Board bill amid ongoing court challenge
item.description: The Alabama State Legislature has passed a second iteration of the Trussville personnel board bill—a glorified legislative band aid meant to repair potential legal issues regarding the city’s split from the Jefferson County Personnel Board—as the prior law remains tangled up in the courts.

item.title: Trussville Council approves track financing following vote reversal
item.description: After several hard-fought laps and a last-minute vote reversal, the Trussville City Council unanimously approved an ordinance Tuesday night authorizing a refinancing plan that’s expected to provide about $922,000 for a new track and related improvements at Hewitt-Trussville High School (HTHS).
